plugin.hello_world.lay_aide: Drag to move, the handle to resize. Shift or Ctrl for a multiple selection: the LAST one clicked is the reference for alignments.
plugin.hello_world.lay_sel2: Select at least two elements: the last one clicked is the reference.
plugin.hello_world.lay_tr_non: PiP off the bottom edge: served from the previous frame (one frame behind on the inset alone; the output stays sliced).
plugin.hello_world.lay_tr_oui: PiP at the bottom edge: served from the current frame.
plugin.hello_world.omega_aide: No measurable effect on the processing chain.
plugin.hello_world.t_aide: These three settings are read by the orchestrator, not by the container: changing them REDEPLOYS the plugin (brief interruption).
plugin.hello_world.titre_note: Example plugin. Not meant for production: it shows the contract a plugin must honour, and checks that a fresh install really produces a picture.
type.hello_world.cfg.format.help: Picked from the list in Settings → Video. You do not type pixels: a hand-written 1920×1080 says nothing about scan or bit depth. Used ONLY when no input is wired — with a source, the format comes from the flow.
type.hello_world.cfg.format.label: Output format (with no input wired)
type.hello_world.cfg.log_level.label: Log level
type.hello_world.cfg.slice_mode.help: Hidden on purpose: the setting that matters is the global switch in Settings → Video.
type.hello_world.cfg.slice_mode.label: Slice mode
type.hello_world.cfg.tally_label_col.hel: Which column of the source table provides the text. ⚠ This setting is read by the ORCHESTRATOR (tally_targets hook), not by the container: it only takes effect on redeploy, unlike the settings on the page.
type.hello_world.cfg.tally_level.help: Which levels colour the dots. SEVERAL may be picked: tally accumulates, the same source being followable on several destination chains. No choice = the container's production. A level is a named entity of the site (Settings → Labels & Tally), not a band number from a protocol. Read by the orchestrator, like the label.
type.hello_world.cfg.tally_level.label: Tally levels followed
type.hello_world.label: Hello World
